steps.name: Check required sections
steps.run:
BODY=$(printf '%s\n' "$BODY" | tr -d '\r' | perl -0pe 's/<!--.*?-->//gs')
section() { printf '%s\n' "$BODY" | awk -v h="$1" 'index($0, h) == 1 { f = 1; next } /^## / { f = 0 } f'; }

OK=true
while IFS= read -r header; do
  printf '%s\n' "$BODY" | grep -qF "$header" || OK=false
done < <(perl -0pe 's/<!--.*?-->//gs' .github/pull_request_template.md | grep "^## ")

section "## Checklist" | grep -qE '^\s*- \[[xX]\]' || OK=false
[[ "$(section "## Please describe to which degree" | tr -d '[:space:]')" =~ ^(\.\.\.)?$ ]] && OK=false

pipelines.name: Draft new release

steps.name: Check this is a release branch
steps.run:
case "${BRANCH}" in
  release/*) ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::releases are drafted from a release branch, not ${BRANCH}"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

version="v$(jq -r '.version' package.json)"
echo "version=${version}" | tee -a "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
if [[ "${version}" =~ -rc\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "rc=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "rc=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Verify the release line does not diverge from main
Generate release notes
steps.run:
tags=$(git -c versionsort.suffix=-rc tag --list 'v[0-9]*' --sort=-v:refname)
if [[ "${PRERELEASE}" != 'true' ]]; then
  tags=$(grep -v -- '-rc.' <<< "${tags}")
fi
previous=$(grep -A1 -xF "${TAG}" <<< "${tags}" | tail -1)
echo "generating notes from ${previous}"

mise //:notes --tag "${TAG}" --previous "${previous}"
cat misc/release/notes.md

steps.name: Create draft release
steps.run:
gh release create "${TAG}" \
  --repo "${REPO}" \
  --target "${BRANCH}" \
  --draft \
  --verify-tag \
  --prerelease="${PRERELEASE}" \
  --notes-file misc/release/notes.md \
  docker/docker-compose.yml \
  docker/docker-compose.rootless.yml \
  docker/example.env \
  docker/hwaccel.ml.yml \
  docker/hwaccel.transcoding.yml \
  docker/prometheus.yml \
  *.apk

steps.name: Publish release
steps.run:
previous=$(gh api "repos/${REPO}/releases/latest" --jq '.tag_name' 2>/dev/null || true)
# version-sort the two and see which wins: if it is TAG, it supersedes the current latest
newest=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "${previous}" "${TAG}" | sort --version-sort | tail -1)

if [[ "${PRERELEASE}" == "true" ]]; then
  latest=false
elif [[ -z "${previous}" || "${newest}" == "${TAG}" ]]; then
  latest=true
else
  # an older release line, published after a newer one
  latest=false
fi

discussion=()
if [[ "${TAG}" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.0(-rc\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then
  discussion=(--discussion-category Announcements)
fi

echo "publishing ${TAG} (latest=${latest}, prerelease=${PRERELEASE}, previous=${previous:-none})"
gh release edit "${TAG}" \
  --repo "${REPO}" \
  --draft=false \
  --latest="${latest}" \
  --prerelease="${PRERELEASE}" \
  "${discussion[@]}"

pipelines.name: Update F-Droid Repo

steps.name: Update F-Droid repo
steps.run:
VERSION_CODE=$(yq '.version' mobile/pubspec.yaml | cut -d+ -f2)
export VERSION_CODE

NEW_ENTRY=$(yq -P '
  [.assets[] | select(.name == "app-release.apk")] as $matches |
  with(select($matches | length == 0); error("app-release.apk not found in release assets")) |
  {
    "url": $matches[0].browser_download_url,
    "sha256sum": ($matches[0].digest | sub("^sha256:", "")),
    "date": (.published_at | split("T") | .[0]),
    "version-code": env(VERSION_CODE)
  } | .date tag= "!!timestamp"
' <<< "$RELEASE")
export NEW_ENTRY

git clone --depth 1 "https://oauth2:${GITLAB_TOKEN}@gitlab.futo.org/fdroid/repo-v2.git" fdroid-repo
cd fdroid-repo

yq -i '
  with(select([.apks[] | select(."version-code" == env(VERSION_CODE))] | length > 0); error("version-code already in index")) |
  .apks = [env(NEW_ENTRY)] + .apks
' apps/Immich/index.yml

git config user.name "Immich Release Bot"
git config user.email "bot@immich.app"
git commit -am "Immich: add version-code ${VERSION_CODE} (${TAG})"
git push

steps.name: Find translation PR

set -euo pipefail

PR=$(gh pr list --repo $GITHUB_REPOSITORY --author weblate --json number,mergeable)
echo "$PR"

PR_NUMBER=$(echo "$PR" | jq '
  if length == 1 then
    .[0].number
  else
    error("Expected exactly 1 entry, got \(length)")
  end
' 2>&1) || exit 1

echo "PR_NUMBER=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
echo "Selected PR $PR_NUMBER"

if ! echo "$PR" | jq -e '.[0].mergeable == "MERGEABLE"'; then
  echo "PR is not mergeable"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Commit translations
steps.run:
curl --fail-with-body -X POST -H "Authorization: Token $WEBLATE_TOKEN" "$WEBLATE_HOST/api/components/$WEBLATE_COMPONENT/repository/" -d operation=commit
curl --fail-with-body -X POST -H "Authorization: Token $WEBLATE_TOKEN" "$WEBLATE_HOST/api/components/$WEBLATE_COMPONENT/repository/" -d operation=push

steps.name: Merge PR
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

REVIEW_ID=$(gh api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/reviews" --field event='APPROVE' --field body='Automatically merging translations PR' \
  | jq '.id')
echo "REVIEW_ID=$REVIEW_ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
gh pr merge "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --auto --squash

steps.name: Wait for PR to merge
steps.run:
# So we clean up no matter what
set +e

for i in {1..100}; do
  if gh pr view "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json state | jq -e '.state == "MERGED"'; then
    echo "PR merged"
    exit 0
  else
    echo "PR not merged yet, waiting..."
    sleep 6
  fi
done
echo "PR did not merge in time"
gh api -X PUT "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/reviews/$REVIEW_ID/dismissals" --field message='Merge attempt timed out' --field event='DISMISS'
gh pr merge "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --disable-auto
exit 1
